title: Enable amount formatting with currency symbols
summary: Amount formatting now supports displaying currency symbols or ISO codes before or after values using AL format-string tokens, with a new Default position option that defers to General Ledger Setup settings.
key_points: Currency Symbol Position enum gains Default value with IDs re-mapped
Amount formatting uses AL `<S,...>` tokens to embed currency text as part of formatting
Foreign currencies can now inherit position settings from General Ledger Setup when their position is Default
Upgrade code preserves existing configuration across all country layers
Tests split into session-isolated codeunits covering symbol/code combinations and positions
quote: enables amount and unit-amount controls to display configured currency symbols or ISO currency codes before or after the formatted value
